title: Power Rankings: East elite now league's beasts
heading: 2004-05 Power Rankings: Week 20

rankings.summaryHtml: First team to win 50 games this season. First team to clinch a playoff berth this season. First team to post two 10-game win streaks this season. In short, no one's hotter.
rankings.summaryText: First team to win 50 games this season. First team to clinch a playoff berth this season. First team to post two 10-game win streaks this season. In short, no one's hotter.

rankings.summaryHtml: Prince looks more like a Most Improved Player favorite every day ... and Gar Heard's fortunes as interim coach (3-0 in this fill-in stint compared to 2-4 last time) are improving, too.
rankings.summaryText: Prince looks more like a Most Improved Player favorite every day ... and Gar Heard's fortunes as interim coach (3-0 in this fill-in stint compared to 2-4 last time) are improving, too.

rankings.summaryHtml: Nash says his hamstring is feeling a little better. Better yet, after a nice win at Memphis, Suns are quietly 8-3 since the All-Star break, beating Spurs, Pistons, Sonics, Mavs and Nuggets.
rankings.summaryText: Nash says his hamstring is feeling a little better. Better yet, after a nice win at Memphis, Suns are quietly 8-3 since the All-Star break, beating Spurs, Pistons, Sonics, Mavs and Nuggets.

rankings.summaryHtml: For the seventh straight full season, Spurs have won 50 games. But this group is only 1-3 without Duncan, so expect a longer rest after this ankle twist to ensure TD's playoff health.
rankings.summaryText: For the seventh straight full season, Spurs have won 50 games. But this group is only 1-3 without Duncan, so expect a longer rest after this ankle twist to ensure TD's playoff health.

rankings.summaryHtml: Trust us: Coach McMillan is far more concerned about the injury loss of Radmanovic than reports of the season's first locker-room grumbling about minutes, roles, shots, etc.
rankings.summaryText: Trust us: Coach McMillan is far more concerned about the injury loss of Radmanovic than reports of the season's first locker-room grumbling about minutes, roles, shots, etc.

rankings.summaryHtml: Ricky Ricky is making a serious Sixth Man push. And Celts can't stop winning, even though they guard almost no one.
rankings.summaryText: Ricky Ricky is making a serious Sixth Man push. And Celts can't stop winning, even though they guard almost no one.

rankings.summaryHtml: Now that the baton has been passed, let's be real. Until Dampier and Stackhouse return, it probably doesn't matter who's coaching. Mavs won't be a factor without those two healthy.
rankings.summaryText: Now that the baton has been passed, let's be real. Until Dampier and Stackhouse return, it probably doesn't matter who's coaching. Mavs won't be a factor without those two healthy.

rankings.summaryHtml: Rockets haven't been this far over .500 since 1996-97. But they really don't feel like celebrating after losing Juwan for a while.
rankings.summaryText: Rockets haven't been this far over .500 since 1996-97. But they really don't feel like celebrating after losing Juwan for a while.

rankings.summaryHtml: Gasol and Bonzi are back, but it's clear that Grizz have an underrated bench and a coach who deserves COY consideration whether or not he has been there all season.
rankings.summaryText: Gasol and Bonzi are back, but it's clear that Grizz have an underrated bench and a coach who deserves COY consideration whether or not he has been there all season.

rankings.summaryHtml: Interesting stat: Nuggets now have more wins with Furious George in charge (18) than they had in the first 42 games (17).
rankings.summaryText: Interesting stat: Nuggets now have more wins with Furious George in charge (18) than they had in the first 42 games (17).

rankings.summaryHtml: With six of seven on the road and Jamison ailing, Wiz face the threat of joining Cleveland, Chicago and Orlando on the slide.
rankings.summaryText: With six of seven on the road and Jamison ailing, Wiz face the threat of joining Cleveland, Chicago and Orlando on the slide.

rankings.summaryHtml: At 7-7 since the Webber deal, and with Miller out now, you have to start wondering if Kings will slip all the way down to No. 7 and into a first-round series against (ugh) Spurs or Suns.
rankings.summaryText: At 7-7 since the Webber deal, and with Miller out now, you have to start wondering if Kings will slip all the way down to No. 7 and into a first-round series against (ugh) Spurs or Suns.

rankings.summaryHtml: Carlisle won't win 50 games for the first time in four seasons, but he has to be a Coach of the Year factor if Pacers can make the playoffs after all they've been through.
rankings.summaryText: Carlisle won't win 50 games for the first time in four seasons, but he has to be a Coach of the Year factor if Pacers can make the playoffs after all they've been through.

rankings.summaryHtml: Under Flip, Wolves were a game under .500. Under McHale, they're 9-8 and (uh-oh) four behind Denver in the loss column.
rankings.summaryText: Under Flip, Wolves were a game under .500. Under McHale, they're 9-8 and (uh-oh) four behind Denver in the loss column.

rankings.summaryHtml: Just when it appeared you could exclude Jersey from playoff consideration, this is the only Eastern Conference resident outside the top three on any kind of roll.
rankings.summaryText: Just when it appeared you could exclude Jersey from playoff consideration, this is the only Eastern Conference resident outside the top three on any kind of roll.

rankings.summaryHtml: After going 7-4 in February, Bulls are 4-7 in March and still have seven more games to play this month. And it hasn't helped matters that they're 0-4 against New Jersey.
rankings.summaryText: After going 7-4 in February, Bulls are 4-7 in March and still have seven more games to play this month. And it hasn't helped matters that they're 0-4 against New Jersey.

rankings.summaryHtml: Our man Stephen A. has put the heat squarely on Coach O'Brien. But perhaps this thumb injury is just the sort of bizarro-world spark Iverson needs to carry Philly into the playoffs.

rankings.summaryHtml: This probably isn't the week that pressure will ease on anyone in Cleveland. Cavs could be flirting with .500 after a home date with Detroit and trips to Houston and Dallas.
rankings.summaryText: This probably isn't the week that pressure will ease on anyone in Cleveland. Cavs could be flirting with .500 after a home date with Detroit and trips to Houston and Dallas.

rankings.summaryHtml: Francis. Augmon. Weisbrod v. T-Mac. A coaching change. Things are unraveling so fast for this former feel-good team and poor Grant Hill that you don't know where to start.
rankings.summaryText: Francis. Augmon. Weisbrod v. T-Mac. A coaching change. Things are unraveling so fast for this former feel-good team and poor Grant Hill that you don't know where to start.

rankings.summaryHtml: Orlando was 45-37 in its first season without Shaq. Lakers, presently on a 40-42 pace, would probably make the playoffs if they could somehow match that Magic effort.
rankings.summaryText: Orlando was 45-37 in its first season without Shaq. Lakers, presently on a 40-42 pace, would probably make the playoffs if they could somehow match that Magic effort.

rankings.summaryHtml: Clippers really could have been a contender for No. 8, but they can't win the close ones for the umpteenth straight season. Twelve of L.A.'s last 16 losses are by five points or less.
rankings.summaryText: Clippers really could have been a contender for No. 8, but they can't win the close ones for the umpteenth straight season. Twelve of L.A.'s last 16 losses are by five points or less.

rankings.summaryHtml: Who saw this coming? With two wins over Sacramento sandwiched around a road upset of Phoenix, Montgomery is suddenly having a better March than Stanford.
rankings.summaryText: Who saw this coming? With two wins over Sacramento sandwiched around a road upset of Phoenix, Montgomery is suddenly having a better March than Stanford.

rankings.summaryHtml: Life on the road is as big an issue as any. Milwaukee is just 7-25 in away games, with all seven wins coming against East foes.
rankings.summaryText: Life on the road is as big an issue as any. Milwaukee is just 7-25 in away games, with all seven wins coming against East foes.

rankings.summaryHtml: Raps are 21-24 since trading Vince. Not bad, actually, but not good enough to close all wounds opened by Vince's renaissance.
rankings.summaryText: Raps are 21-24 since trading Vince. Not bad, actually, but not good enough to close all wounds opened by Vince's renaissance.

rankings.summaryHtml: Bold prediction II: Three losing seasons is about to become four, because Knicks -- with just two road wins in 2005 -- have way too many roadies left (10) to finish 14-4.

rankings.summaryHtml: Only four more chances remain to spruce up that 0-12 record against Southwest Division neighbors. One game each against Dallas and Memphis, and two more against Houston.

rankings.summaryHtml: The depths of Utah's struggles are simply hard to believe. Jerry Sloan has been stuck on 937 victories, one shy of tying Red Auerbach, since the first Jazz game of the month on March 2.

rankings.summaryHtml: Well, it's back to reality after the breakthrough road triumph in Toronto. Hawks just completed an 0-4 homestand, surrendering no fewer than 106 points in any of the losses.
